description: Fixed paragraph-level autoregressive traces. Version 5 extends the three original paragraphs, adds two new paragraphs, and keeps word-group attention for split-token words.

join.none: Append token with no prefix; used for first token.
join.space: Add a space before this token.

token_policy.tokenization: Educational tokenization, not exact GPT tokenization. Longer words are deliberately split into plausible chunks to make tokens visibly different from words.
token_policy.attention: Renderer should draw every link listed. Attention is token-level, but if one chunk of a split word is referenced, the data includes the other chunks of that same word as related attention targets.
token_policy.candidates: Each step contains the selected token and plausible alternatives with normalized fake probabilities.

paragraphs.text: A token never exists in isolation. Each new token gathers context from the sequence around it and contributes to a representation larger than itself. Meaning emerges from these connections as attention transforms a sequence into a network of relationships. Information can travel across distant parts of the sequence without relying on recurrence. The resulting context influences every prediction that follows.

paragraphs.text: Attention determines which parts of the past remain relevant in the present. Query and key interactions reveal where information should flow, while softmax transforms attention scores into probabilities. Every prediction reshapes the landscape for the token that follows. Some signals become stronger while others fade into the background. The model continuously updates its understanding as new tokens arrive.

paragraphs.text: Multiple attention heads explore the same sequence from different perspectives. Some capture local structure while others connect distant ideas across the context window. Together they create a richer picture of language than any single attention path could provide. Different heads can focus on different relationships at the same moment. Their combined output forms a more complete representation of context.

paragraphs.text: Context is not stored in a single location. It emerges from interactions between many tokens distributed across the sequence. A word can take on different meanings depending on the information surrounding it. Attention helps the model determine which signals matter most in a given situation. The same token may contribute differently from one prediction to the next.

paragraphs.text: Language generation is a continuous process of prediction and revision. Each selected token becomes part of the context for future decisions. Earlier choices influence which possibilities remain likely later in the sequence. Small changes can propagate through many subsequent predictions. Meaning emerges gradually as the sequence unfolds.
